run_eval: run M4T evaluation on a data file using a UnitY model translator and compute quality metrics
build_data_pipeline: build a fairseq2 data pipeline from TSV or JSON data files with audio decoding and text tokenization
load_checkpoint: load a UnitY model checkpoint from a file and load its state dict into the model components
adjust_output_for_corrupted_inputs: adjust model outputs by filtering valid sequences and replacing corrupted inputs with dummy outputs
main: run the M4T evaluation CLI with argparse arguments for data file, task, target language, and output path
